Estimate: the plate is about 26 cm across including the rim, and the piece of lasagna measures roughly 8 x 7 cm. At a height of about 4 cm that gives a volume of about 220 cm³. Lasagna has a density of about 1 g/cm³, so it weighs around 200 g. The sauce on top is part of that figure, though it could be listed separately. I counted a thin layer of sauce, about 30 g, as its own item and gave the lasagna body 170 g.
